Elena, Marco —

Thanks for the questions. I pulled together two concrete options (attached calc) so procurement has a line-item view. Short version below; full numbers attached (axonuplift_calc_20270413.xlsx).

Option A — Concierge Bridge + Annualize (recommended)
- Immediate uplift: +40% committed units for 90 days to cover pilot burst
- Concierge credit: 60% offset of incremental cost for first 90 days (applied as a credit on the next invoice)
- Co-term: move renewal to 2028-01-01 by prorating the remainder of 2027 across the uplifted commitment; single amendment, single invoice (amendment effective date 2027-05-01)
- Net impact: minimal cashflow change month-to-month; estimated 3% ARR uplift vs baseline in year 1 after credits expire

Option B — Upfront Voucher + Monthly Proration
- Upfront voucher equal to 3 months of uplift cost (invoiced immediately, refundable as credit over next three invoices)
- Co-term proration kept conservative: we apply credit only to committed portion, overages billed separately
- Net impact: clearer audit trail for finance but requires separate line on invoice for voucher redemption

Data residency: no change — additional capacity will be provisioned in your existing region and logging/audit settings remain intact. Soojin will coordinate with infra to confirm.

Attached: axonuplift_calc_20270413.xlsx (detailed line-item proration and sample invoice mock)

Next steps I propose:
1) You and Marco confirm preference (A or B) by 2027-04-19
2) If A, legal/finance will prepare a single amendment; if B, we can draft a voucher invoice + short amendment for co-terming
3) Ben/Soji will schedule a 30-min pricing signoff call the week of 2027-04-26

-David
